usageNotes: Use this to start a stopped or failed system service on a specific PVE node; the target node must be online and reachable by the cluster. Requires Sys.Modify on /nodes/{node}. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task endpoint to confirm the service reached the running state.

examples.summary: Start the pveproxy service on node pve1 (e.g. after manual stop or crash)

tips: The return value is a UPID task string; use get_nodes_node_tasks_upid_status to poll completion.
Starting corosync or pve-cluster on a node that is already joined may cause quorum disruption — verify cluster health first.
If pvedaemon or pveproxy is the target, be aware that in-flight API connections may drop briefly during the restart window.
sshd is included in the enum; starting it via the API requires an already-working API connection — useful for re-enabling SSH after an accidental stop.
Not all services support start if their dependencies are missing (e.g. corosync requires a valid cluster.conf).
